findings.title: HSTS is not enabled
findings.message: Program.cs configures HTTPS redirection but never calls UseHsts(), so browsers are not instructed to pin HTTPS.
findings.remediation: Add app.UseHsts() for non-development environments before UseHttpsRedirection().
